زِوَرٌّ A vehement pace. (S, K.) ―
-b2- Vehement; or strong: (K:) but to what applied is not particularized. (TA.) ―
-b3- Applied to a camel, Strong; hardy; (TA;) prepared for journeys. (K.) And زِوَرَّةُ أَسْفَارٍ, applied to a she-camel, Prepared for journeys: or having an inclination to one side, by reason of her briskness, or sprightliness. (TA.) [See أَزْوَرُ.] ―
-b4- See also زَوْرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
